### Professional Summary

Suleman Zaheer is a Pakistani software engineer and entrepreneur born on 1 February 2007 in Lahore, Pakistan. He is enrolled in a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science at the University of Engineering and Technology (UET) Lahore. He is the founder of SAMStack Studio, a software development agency in Lahore. His technical work spans full-stack web development (MERN/Next.js/Laravel), cross-platform mobile development (Flutter), desktop application engineering (Electron.js), Python automation, AI/LLM integration, and data analysis. He is also an Urdu poet and writer.
